_disclaimer: Fictional, illustrative stand-in for a Devin demo. Not American Express policy.

controls.title: CDD trigger: new account
controls.requirement: Apply CDD on every new card application including supplementary cards.

controls.title: CDD trigger: suspicion
controls.requirement: Apply CDD on suspicion of ML/TF/fraud regardless of value.

controls.title: CDD trigger: doubts on data
controls.requirement: Apply CDD when veracity or adequacy of identification data is in doubt.

controls.title: CDD trigger: doubts on identity of person interacting
controls.requirement: Apply CDD when it is unclear whether the person is the card member or authorised to act.

controls.title: Individual identification data
controls.requirement: Collect identification data for every applicant.

controls.title: Supplementary card member data
controls.requirement: Name and DOB; ID number only if primary is High risk.

controls.title: Documentary verification
controls.requirement: Government photo ID plus liveness/selfie match.

controls.title: Non-documentary verification
controls.requirement: US applicants passing bureau/database checks may skip documentary verification.

controls.title: Verification timing
controls.requirement: Verify identity before account opening.

controls.title: Verification failure
controls.requirement: Decline if identity not verified within 30 days; FIU triage.

controls.title: Purpose and intended nature
controls.requirement: Collect expected monthly spend band, source of income, annual income.

controls.title: EDD for High risk
controls.requirement: Source of funds (and wealth >USD 250k/yr spend) plus Level 2 approval.

controls.title: PEP is always EDD
controls.requirement: PEPs, family members and close associates receive EDD.

controls.title: Event-driven refresh
controls.requirement: Refresh on cross-border address change, name change, screening hit, profile mismatch.

controls.title: Simplified due diligence
controls.requirement: SDD not permitted for consumer cards.

controls.title: Exit on inability to complete CDD
controls.requirement: Suspend, close after 60 days, SAR consideration.

controls.title: KYB trigger: onboarding
controls.requirement: Apply KYB to new merchants, sub-merchants and corporate clients.

controls.title: KYB trigger: change of ownership/control
controls.requirement: Re-perform KYB on change of ownership or control.

controls.title: Entity identification data
controls.requirement: Collect entity identification data.

controls.title: Entity verification sources
controls.requirement: Company register extract (<=90 days) or vendor registry API; TIN match.

controls.title: UBO ownership prong
controls.requirement: Identify natural persons owning directly >=25% of equity.

controls.title: Indirect ownership
controls.requirement: Identify indirect owners where reasonably apparent; no multiplication method.

controls.title: UBO control prong
controls.requirement: Identify one senior manager with significant responsibility.

controls.title: UBO data elements
controls.requirement: Name, DOB, residential address, ID number, nationality (primary), ownership %.

controls.title: UBO verification
controls.requirement: IDV or certified ID for >=25% owners and control person.

controls.title: No UBO identified
controls.requirement: Record 'no 25% owner' and proceed with control-prong individual only.

controls.title: Beneficial-ownership register use
controls.requirement: Register may be consulted for reference; discrepancies resolved with client.

controls.title: Bearer shares
controls.requirement: Entities with bearer shares are prohibited.

controls.title: Nature of business and purpose
controls.requirement: Business description, expected volume, ticket size, CNP %, countries of sale.

controls.title: EDD for High-risk entities
controls.requirement: Source of funds, adverse media, site inspection, Level 2 approval.

controls.title: PEP in ownership/control
controls.requirement: Any PEP owner/director/control person triggers EDD.

controls.title: Verification timing
controls.requirement: Verify before activation for Standard and High risk.

controls.title: Low-risk deferred verification
controls.requirement: Low-risk merchants may activate with funding held; UBO verification within 90 days.

controls.title: Event-driven refresh
controls.requirement: Refresh on ownership/control change, MCC change, screening hit, chargebacks >1.5%, volume >3x for 2 months.

controls.title: Exit on inability to complete KYB
controls.requirement: Decline/terminate and SAR consideration.

controls.title: Risk factors
controls.requirement: Weighted factors: geography, product, legal form, MCC, PEP, volume, channel, ownership complexity.

controls.title: Score to tier
controls.requirement: 0-29 Low, 30-59 Medium, 60+ High.

controls.title: Periodic review cycle
controls.requirement: Maximum interval between full CDD refreshes by tier.

controls.title: Sanctions lists
controls.requirement: OFAC, UN, EU consolidated, UK HMT, plus local lists from addendum.

controls.title: PEP senior management approval
controls.requirement: Level 2+ approval to establish or continue PEP relationships.

controls.title: PEP source of funds / wealth
controls.requirement: Document source of funds; source of wealth above spend threshold.

controls.title: PEP enhanced ongoing monitoring
controls.requirement: 12-month review, lower monitoring thresholds.

controls.title: Former PEPs
controls.requirement: Retain PEP treatment for 12 months after leaving function, then risk-based.

controls.title: Complex / unusual transactions
controls.requirement: Always escalate complex, unusually large, unusual-pattern or no-apparent-purpose transactions.

controls.title: Group-wide information
controls.requirement: Consider group-wide relationship data in investigations.

controls.title: STR filing (non-US)
controls.requirement: File STRs with local FIU per country addendum.

controls.title: FIU request response time
controls.requirement: Respond to FIU / law-enforcement requests within 10 business days.

controls.title: Tipping-off prohibition
controls.requirement: No tipping off; neutral templates.

controls.title: CDD record retention
controls.requirement: Retain CDD records 5 years after relationship end or decline.

controls.title: Transaction record retention
controls.requirement: Retain transaction records 5 years from transaction date.
